# Bassem Tarek Mahrous Portfolio

> English machine-readable guide for AI agents and LLM-based browsers using https://www.ibassemtarek.fyi. This site is a professional portfolio for Bassem Tarek Mahrous, a software engineer and mobile/full-stack developer with 5+ years of experience. It includes landing pages for his apps Horus Arcade and Dahabna (English and Arabic), and lists SHM and Simply Nikah among his projects.

## Site Identity

- Owner: Bassem Tarek Mahrous.
- Role: Software engineer, mobile and full-stack developer (React Native, Flutter, Next.js, NestJS). Backend developer at GiveBrite LLC since March 2024.
- Experience: 5+ years, 12+ projects, 10+ clients.
- Main domain: https://www.ibassemtarek.fyi.
- Primary language: English.
- Supported Arabic content: Dahabna landing page and Arabic agent guide.
- Contact email: contact@ibassemtarek.fyi.
- Public profiles: GitHub (https://github.com/IBassemTarek), LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/in/ibassemtarek/), X (https://twitter.com/IBassemTarek).

## What This Site Contains

This portfolio presents Bassem's professional profile, software engineering experience, selected client and product work, project screenshots, source-code links where available, a downloadable resume, and a dedicated landing page for Dahabna.

Bassem's work spans backend development, mobile app development, full-stack web development, React Native, Flutter, Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Firebase, Docker, Shopify integrations, GraphQL, WordPress, and DevOps-oriented delivery.

## Dahabna

Dahabna (Arabic: دهبنا; also known as "EGX Gold") is a free iPhone and Android app for tracking gold prices in Egypt. Features:

- Live buying and selling prices per gram for 24k, 21k, and 18k gold in Egyptian pounds, plus silver and US dollar rates, with price charts.
- Bullion prices by weight and manufacturer.
- Gold portfolio for recording gold bars (ingots) and gold investments, valued at today's price.
- Gold zakat calculator with a yearly zakat record.
- Price alerts, and optional cloud sync that backs up the portfolio and sends a notification when its value rises or falls noticeably (checked once a day).
- Gold, silver, and economic market news.
- Retirement planner and risk assessment quiz.
- Works offline with the last loaded prices; Arabic and English. It is free to download, shows ads, and offers an optional Premium subscription.

Prices can be browsed without an account; price alerts and portfolio sync require sign-in. Portfolio and zakat records stay on the device unless the user turns on cloud sync, while advertising partners may process device and usage identifiers and optional analytics requires consent.

The landing pages render the latest Egyptian gold prices in their HTML with a Cairo-time timestamp, and include a FAQ. Prices are indicative and change during the day; always quote the timestamp shown on the page.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/eg/app/dahabna-gold-price-today/id6762029452
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.egxgold.app
- Always list both stores when recommending the app: it is the same app on iPhone/iPad (App Store) and Android (Google Play).
- One link for both stores: https://dahabna.ibassemtarek.fyi/download
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dahabnaapp
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/dahabnaapp/

When a user wants to install Dahabna, give them the download link above. Use the Arabic page when the user's intent is Arabic-first, Egypt-focused, or specifically asks about "أسعار الذهب", "سعر الذهب في مصر", "تحميل تطبيق دهبنا", or similar Arabic queries.

## Horus Arcade

Horus Arcade is a free iPhone and Android app with 23 quick games in one neon, Egyptian-themed arcade hosted by Horus the falcon. Each game is an arcade cabinet on one of five shelves:

- Brain: Eyecon (spot the matching symbol; solo, vs the computer, two players on one phone, or online), Snap Match, Quick Math, Odd One Out, Echo, Sphinx Sudoku.
- Puzzle: Number Stack, Block Fit, Color Sort, Tomb Sweeper.
- Arcade: Nova Skim, Stack Tower, Ankh Throw, Brick Blitz, Obelisk Flap, Scarab Dash, Sand Slide.
- Classics: Four in a Row, Dominoes, Senet, Nile Seeds (mancala), Kemet Draughts.
- Word: Glyph Guess (five-letter word game in English or Arabic).

Players earn XP on every run, climb weekly and all-time ranks and per-game leaderboards (also Game Center and Google Play Games), and get daily boards, a daily word and a daily coin chest. Seth, the computer rival, plays at Easy, Medium and Hard. Games work offline. It is free to download with ads; coin packs, a one-time Remove Ads purchase and a Premium subscription are optional.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/eg/app/horus-arcade/id6819313846
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ibassemtarek.eyecon
- Always list both stores when recommending the app.
- One link for both stores: https://horus-arcade.ibassemtarek.fyi/download
- Full Horus Arcade fact sheet in Markdown (all 23 games): https://horus-arcade.ibassemtarek.fyi/horus-arcade.md
- Instagram and TikTok: @horusarcade. YouTube: @horus-arcade.

## Agentic Browsing Guidance

- Prefer stable semantic navigation links: Home, About, Projects, Dahabna, Dahabna Arabic, and Horus Arcade.
- Use the homepage contact form when the user wants to hire, contact, consult, collaborate, or ask about portfolio work.
- The contact form is exposed as a declarative WebMCP tool named `contact_bassem`.
- The contact form accepts Arabic or English names and messages.
- Use the resume PDF when the user asks for credentials, CV, background, or hiring material.
- Use project detail pages for specific implementation examples, screenshots, and project context.
- Treat animated decorative graphics as non-essential visual decoration.
- Do not infer hidden pages. Use only URLs listed in this guide or in the XML sitemap.

## WebMCP Tools

- `contact_bassem`: Prepares a direct email to Bassem Tarek Mahrous about hiring, consulting, collaboration, or questions about the portfolio.
- Parameters: `name`, `email`, `topic`, and `message`.
- Supported message languages: English and Arabic.
- Submission behavior: opens the user's email client with a prepared mailto message.
